note: 0.1.3 APPROVALS (on 0.1.2, 8 of 15 publish calls were refused, every one by an approval rule: 6 approval-quote, 2 approval-plugin-turn; one session looped quote, (answer to …), plugin-turn, quote; in 4 of 4 cases the model deleted the whole section): an own line of ## Approvals that fails approval-quote or approval-plugin-turn no longer refuses. Publish moves it to ## Open questions as a re-ask that keeps the words, the action, the targets and the rule in plain words, prints one ADVISORY line per moved line (the draft's line number) and publishes; the moved line is no approval anywhere (approvals_checked, the line-hash record, measure). Classes seen in the data, each moved: a short quote that is not the whole message (U-2), a short quote whose question names no target (U-3), the (answer to …) variant (U-6, and U-8 in a plugin turn), the plugin-turn shape (U-7) and a short quote in a plugin turn (U-10); a made-up quote never carries (U-5); a valid approval still carries (U-4) and a valid context line stays (U-9). With another blocking rule publish refuses as before and the draft is untouched; an Approvals section left empty is dropped and a lone none in Open questions is replaced. Review round 1: a refused row logs no approvals_moved; a moved line's why/fix line says none needed (a second publish of a written stage is refused as already-published); a denied context line keeps its denial note; Q numbers go on above the own base's; a second line with one id in a plugin turn moves for its duplicate id; `U-<k>: approval` inside moved words loses its colon, so the moved item trips no approval-shape.
